# Professional Services Operations Overview

## Overview
This dashboard provides Meridian Advisory Group with a comprehensive view of engagement health, consultant utilization, and client satisfaction. It is built for managing partners and delivery leads who need to monitor billable performance, pipeline activity, and on-time delivery across all active engagements.

## Key Metrics
- Active Engagements: 18
- Billable Utilization Rate: 78.4%
- Deliverables On-Time Rate: 86.0%
- Client Satisfaction Score: 4.3 / 5.0
- Proposals in Pipeline: 7

## Insights
- Utilization at 78.4% is below the 80% firm target; two senior consultants are under-allocated and available for new engagements
- Deliverable on-time rate dipped from 91% last quarter; scope changes on 2 engagements are the primary driver
- Client satisfaction score of 4.3 is stable; the Digital Transformation engagement at Apex Corp scores highest at 4.8
